title: רב שימי מחוזנאה

paragraphs: Rav Shimi of Mahoza. Pesahim 42b; Makkot 16a. In Makkot, Rav appears as the objector. The text then reads, ‘Rather, Rav Shimi of Nehardea said.’ It needs examination whether there is a scribal error: perhaps it should read Rav Shimi of Nehardea objected to him, leading to ‘Rather, R' Shimi of Nehardea said.’ Apart from this, it is impossible to say Rav objected to Rav Shimi of Mahoza, since he was not in his generation.
